stateRegistry.name: Government of Karnataka Bhoomi land-record system
stateRegistry.evidence: The official Karnataka land-record entry point is identified by Government land-record materials as Bhoomi, the state land-record management system. The direct host timed out during one anonymous TLS GET attempt; no login or retry through credentials was used.

generalAgency.name: Department of Land Resources, Government of India / DILRMP
generalAgency.scope: National modernization/status reporting for Mandya district; general agency evidence only, not a Mandya city parcel service.
